resources.string: Wibagiwe icyihuse n\'ubwoba bwo gufata inama mu gihugu cyacu, AKILIMO ikubisobanura!
AKILIMO igufasha kongera umusaruro no kunguka byinshi mu murima wawe w\'imyumbati. Reka dutangire!
Nyamuneka soma kandi wemere amategeko n\'amabwiriza
Emera amategeko n\'amabwiriza mbere yo gukomeza

Inama ugirwa na AKILIMO zose zishingiye ku hantu uherereye, ingano y\'umurima wawe n\'ibiciro. Urugero, iyo ubuso bw\'umurima wawe wibeshye ukabugira bunini, bituma utanga igishoro kinini bityo ugahomba. Ku rundi ruhande, niba ubuso bw\'umurima wawe ugereranije ari butoya ugereranije nukuri, ibi biganisha ku kudaha agaciro umusaruro wawe kandi ukaba watakaza amahirwe yo kubona inyungu mu murima wawe.
Nyamuneka wemeze ko wasomye kandi wasobanukiwe iri tangazo ry\'ikurwaho ry\'uburyozwe.
Nyamuneka soma kandi wemere iki cyitonderwa
